title: How to organise the sports and recreation zone | Garage
description:
Holds the gear for the sports this household currently plays, with the in-season kit easiest to grab.

This is the Sports and Recreation Zone in the Garage. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Bikes on wall hooks with bare floor beneath them, one labelled bin per activity, this season's kit at the front of the shelf, and every helmet in the garage belonging to a head that still wears it.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Carry every helmet, ball, racket, and pair of cleats out onto the driveway and match each one to a person who
Straighten: Bikes hang on wall hooks nearest the door so nobody unhooks three to get one out on a Saturday morning.
Shine: Air out and wipe down helmet liners and shin pads, hose the mud off cleats and dry them right through before t
Safety: A helmet that has taken one real impact is finished even if the shell looks perfect, and so is one past the da
Standardize: One labelled bin per activity, and the label carries the sport plus the name of the person it belongs to.
Sustain: The front and back of the shelf trade places the first weekend you turn the heating on, and again the first we

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Every bin carries a sport and a person's name, and this season's kit sits at the front of the shelf.
